record.field: Lists accessible report entry points from account_report client actions. Use action_report_id to describe an entry; report.report_id identifies its native default selection. Returns report names, default variant/section IDs, filter_date_range and pagination. An empty list means no matching entries.

Builds reusable configuration from action_report_id returned by accounting_report_list, using the companies currently selected in Odoo. A matching current browser report supplies its native options and source action; otherwise native defaults apply.
Returns report_config, currencies, available_option_overrides, a paginated line_catalog and report_config_ref. report_config contains action_report_id and options. options.companies lists the companies included by native reporting, which may be fewer than the current selection. Its options retain native settings and choices, including report_id and columns. report_config.options.columns contains all native column definitions in order; expression_label can repeat across groups. Match report_id to available_variants or sections for the selected report name. Currency details are listed separately by ID. Returned options are a subset of the saved settings. aging_based_on is base_on_invoice_date for invoice dates or base_on_maturity_date for due dates.
Use native names in option_overrides. journals and account_type accept {id, selected} objects. In resolved native options, no selected entries means all listed entries apply. Use accounting_report_select to change identity or options. If the user changes the company selection, describe the report again to obtain a new reference.
AI Tool: Select Accounting Report Identity

Selects a variant or section from an exact report_config_ref. Use choice={kind: "variant", id: ...} with an ID from report_config.options.available_variants, or kind: "section" with an ID from report_config.options.sections. These lists belong to the supplied configuration. A report can serve different roles in different lists; use the matching kind. Returns the same description as describe. Optional option_overrides uses native option names and selection objects. Checks reference ownership, selected companies and report access.
ai['result'] = record._ai_tool_accounting_report_select(tool_context=ai, report_config_ref=report_config_ref, choice=choice, option_overrides=option_overrides, offset=offset, limit=limit)
AI Tool: Get Accounting Report Values

Computes native report values from report_config_ref returned by describe or select. Returns report_config, currencies, column_groups, paginated lines, native warnings and the same report_config_ref. An empty warnings object means the report returned no warnings. It does not establish that the accounts are correct, reconciled or compliant. Consider any line-level warning_text as well. report_config.options.columns keeps all native column definitions. Provide at least one expression_label in columns. These labels select row cells across all periods and groups without changing the config. Pagination limits rows, regardless of the number of columns. Each line contains native columns: expression_label, column_group_index, no_format (raw value) and name (formatted value). column_group_index indexes column_groups; forced_options.date identifies that group's period when present, otherwise use report_config.options.date. A configured date range does not mean every value is activity within that range: General Ledger account debit and credit totals include opening amounts. line_ref permits expansion. row_type distinguishes data, totals and load_more summaries. Lines retain native warning_text when present.
ai['result'] = record._ai_tool_accounting_report_get_values(tool_context=ai, report_config_ref=report_config_ref, columns=columns, line_codes=line_codes, offset=offset, limit=limit)
AI Tool: Expand Accounting Report Line

Expands a line_ref issued by get_values or expand_line using its exact saved configuration and column selection. Returns the same report_config, currencies, lines, column_groups and pagination as get_values. Follow returned line_ref values for deeper detail. A load_more reference reloads its parent branch and may repeat earlier lines; do not double-count them. Rows represent report lines, not necessarily accounting records. Initial Balance is an opening summary. Row names are display descriptions; do not infer dimensions absent from the returned data. Lines retain native warning_text when present.

Opens the exact saved report_config_ref using its source action and full native options. Returns opened, report_config, currencies and the reference. If that exact configuration is already displayed, opened is false and reason explains why. Otherwise a client action opens it. Call this tool alone and wait for its result before answering.
AI Tool: Set Working Audit File

Set the working audit file for this session's context-dependent accounting fields, or pass null to clear it. Select the assigned file before querying audit fields with search/read-group. Wait for the setter result before issuing those queries. Clear it before unrelated work or select the new file when the assignment changes. Parent and child sessions keep separate working-file selections. The file's companies and main company must match Odoo's company selector.
Returns the active file, company and period, or audit_context=null when cleared. This does not add company/date domains to ordinary searches, select report options or modify the working file's findings.
AI Tool: Create Audit Working File

Create a native audit working file for the currently selected company and exact dates, using the native local audit type and configured cycles. Select one company in Odoo before calling this tool. Requires confirmation. For branch structures, ask the user to create the file manually in the Accounting application and provide its ID. Returns the file scope, URL and native check progress.

Read the native working file, complete check instructions and notes, company and dates, live cycle progress, and paginated checks. Pass cycle to read the assigned cycle, or omit it to discover all cycles. File checks require manual evidence. Native record count is only a capped hint; it is not a complete evidence count. Progress summarizes native statuses and refresh flags, not a record of agent investigations.
AI Tool: Get Audit Check Action Detail

Return a check's native action in action_detail as an investigation hint, with search and main view XML for record actions. Interpret its domain, active search defaults and search-panel selections using the XML, including filter grouping. Group-by defaults suggest grouping rather than record restrictions. Choose fields and explicit domains for search/read-group, or use accounting-report tools for report actions. Native report IDs and options remain in the action.
No records or report_config_ref are returned. Action context is metadata for interpreting the action; it does not configure subsequent tools. If no action is available, investigate from the check instructions and attached documents. Other executable actions are returned without being run.
AI Tool: Save Audit Cycle Findings

Preview and save a validated batch of findings for one assigned cycle, under native access and review rules. Only non-file checks may be updated. Use reviewed for supported clearance, anomaly for evidenced exceptions, and todo for incomplete or blocked checks. Never formally completes or supervises the working file. Requires confirmation. After saving, returns the updated check codes, native check progress and working-file URL.
For each saved audit note, write a short, plain-language conclusion, normally two or three sentences. State what is established, what is wrong, or what remains unresolved. Include only the decisive facts or amounts and any necessary next action.
Do not repeat the check description, company, period or procedures unless needed to understand the conclusion. Avoid headings such as Scope, Procedures and Evidence. Preserve limitations that change what can be concluded. Use neutral language without mentioning agents.
